text:
Ellie (People Ops): Drafting a paste-ready 'Pre-start + Week1' card managers can drop in invites. Focus: clear owner actions, inclusivity notes for remote hires, and a compact 30/60/90 scaffold. Link to drive: https://redwood.ok/onboard-pastecard :wave:

Ellie (People Ops): Paste-card short: PRE-DAY: confirm laptop & peripherals, file IT provisioning (include access matrix), assign buddy, send intro to squad + timezone. DAY1 AM: welcome + org context (20m), manager 1:1 (20m) = role purpose + success signals, team intros (20m). DAY1 PM: accounts (git/CI), security micro-brief, remote pairing norms. DAY2: product & architecture + product sync. DAY3: local dev + starter PR assigned. DAY4: cross-team intros + draft 30/60/90. DAY5: ship/pair on small change + feedback & inclusion check-in.

Sam (Eng Manager): Nice. Add: a short inclusivity note (check timezone overlap for recurring 1:1s, record sessions when helpful), and a tiny "manager 1:1 script" with prompts.

Ellie (People Ops): Added inclusivity bullets. Manager 1:1 script (10-15m):
- Why this role matters this quarter
- Top 3 priorities + early wins
- Communication & meeting norms (async vs live)
- Feedback rhythm + 1:1 cadence
- Immediate blockers we can remove

Pri (DevEx): Starter PR rubric to paste into PR body:```Summary: one sentence
Why: context
How to run: steps
Checklist: [ ] tests added [ ] lint OK [ ] 1 reviewer from squad``` Also we'll auto-label new-hire PRs as "onboard-starter".

Noah (IT): Managers open IT ticket ASAP: https://redwood.ok/it-newhire. Include start date, hardware needs, and access matrix (VPN, repos, cloud, KMS). Tickets filed before 10:00 PST on start day usually get same-day provisioning. For sensitive keys include manager approval text.

Ellie (People Ops): 30/60/90 scaffold (measurable examples):
- 30d: local dev ready, 1 small PR merged, joined product syncs (evidence: PR link, meeting attendance).
- 60d: own a component area, reduce PR review latency or add tests to reduce flakes (evidence: PRs, CI runs).
- 90d: lead a small feature or postmortem, own a pager rotation, show measurable quality or perf improvement.

Sam (Eng Manager): Also include an "evidence pack" managers should collect for check-ins (PR links, test coverage, short demo).

Lee (new-hire): Quick q: Day3 PR size guidance?

Sam (Eng Manager): Aim small & meaningful: docs fix, single-test, or tiny bug (1-3 files). We'll pair if preferred.

OnboardBot: Calendar block created: Week1 onboarding 10:00-12:00 local daily. Manager, buddy, and new hire invited.

Ellie (People Ops): Final asks for managers: confirm buddy 48h before start, file IT ticket at offer acceptance, paste the card into Day1 invite and record remote sessions if possible. I'll publish the editable card + examples to the drive by EOD. :memo:
